task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick up the red can with orange label using the right arm, transfer it beside the gray cylindrical metal kitchenpot
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用右臂拿起带有橙色标签的红色罐头，将其转移到灰色圆柱形金属厨房锅旁边
